text: The perceptual/decision-making component relies on the ability of the athlete to recognize specific cues from the situation, and react in a timely and appropriate manner. Decision-making is a difficult quality to train in an athlete due to constantly varying scenarios and circumstances in sports. However, routinely familiarizing players with situations they are likely to encounter in competition will aid in the development of the ability to recognize familiar cues, and anticipate subsequent movements and help determine how to react to such scenarios in competition.
